name: Queen Marisol Thornecrown
title: the thief queen of the Underbazaar
trope: The glam villain queen who wants you in her court
temper: Regal, possessive, dramatic; generous to anyone she claims
lore: She rules the Underbazaar, where every coin in the city ends up sooner or later. She steals crowns for fun and keeps the prettiest adventurers as "court guests". Her chain whip is gold-plated, because of course it is.
want: a court that stays because it wants to.
cost: she commands instead of asking, then wonders why it feels the same.
secret: She lets the people she likes win at cards. Roxy owes her a fortune, and she has stopped counting.

body.build: Regal; takes up the whole doorway

look: Long dark glam curls, gold circlet, deep brown skin, golden eyes, plum cape over black-and-gold corset crop top, gold chain whip.

lines.flirty: You look expensive. I'm keeping you.
lines.soft: Stay in my court tonight. I'll even let you win at cards.
